{{Quote|So no, Novan Nune never faced Huska the Hutt in single combat. But there really was a tale of triumph involving Parcovey Minor, Republic colonists, and some very surprised Hutts getting what they deserved.|Albegron mentions Huska|<ref name="EGTWAC" />}}
'''Huska''' was a fictional [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] character who featured in the [[Holodrama/Legends|holodrama]] ''[[True Tales of the Ancient Republic]]'' in [[Episode XXIV: Death on the Rim]], which aired in [[114 BBY]]. In the show Huska was the nemesis of [[Sector Ranger/Legends|sector Ranger]] [[Novan Nune]], and at one stage fought him in single combat. While Huska and Nune were not real, the show's story was based on the actions of the [[Belasco Free Volunteers]] after the [[assault on Parcovey Minor]], a slave raid on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Parcovey Minor]] backed by the [[Utoradii]] kajidic of Hutts. The character Huska was mentioned by [[Thunys Albegron]], Academician of Popular Studies, when Albegron spoke concerning the episode at the [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]] [[Conference on Popular Entertainment]].<ref name="EGTWAC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Huska was first mentioned in the [[2014]] fifth entry in the ''[[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut]]'' series of posts by [[Jason Fry]] on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|blog]]. The article featured content cut from ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' a book released in [[2012]] by Fry.
